summary: The <tbody> section. Takes no props — it places the data rows and gives their cells body context.
useWhen: every Table — the data rows go here

composition.note: Zebra striping is read from each row's position inside this section rather than a prop repeated on every TableRow.

guarantees: cells inside it default to <td>, and `scope` is inferred as `row` when a cell is marked `header`

antiPatterns.dont: rendering rows directly under Table with no TableBody
antiPatterns.why: the browser inserts a tbody anyway, but the head-or-body context does not exist, so cells cannot infer their scope

antiPatterns.dont: an empty TableBody with no empty state
antiPatterns.why: an empty table looks like a broken one — Table has no empty state of its own, so it is the caller's
